svg.title: The software factory
svg.desc: Work enters from a person, an issue tracker, factory intake, the task list and the harness's own feedback. A supervised session or an autonomous run defines it; one start gate, which checks the spec, the grill pass, the approval and the task's dependencies, admits it to the build. Every task then passes the same judge, review, verify and CI checks; outward writes are journalled, and one with no observed result waits for a person. A person merges the pull request. People set the rules in user-only files. Dashed parts are proposed or outside the harness.
svg.text: One gated pipeline for every change, whoever starts it, while people set the rules

g.text: The analyst writes the spec: REQs,
ADRs. The griller asks; the person
loads every routed skill, then writes
code and tests that name the AC ids.
On demand or nightly. run: a fresh
session per task. orca: a worker per
step and a worktree per task, in
backbone/ and the vault, with sources.

svg.text: Policy approves only low-risk docs and
Anything else is escalated to a person,

g.text: In a task worktree or the harness-agent
sandbox, within run's time, attempt and
cost budgets. orca retries a dead step

svg.text: PR with the receipt and risk
A fail goes to the debugger, then

g.text: A regression links to its PR

svg.text: What fails becomes the next task
A person decides; the harness waits
Checked or recorded by the harness
Dashed: proposed, or outside the harness
PEOPLE SET THE RULES · ENFORCED BY HOOKS AND VERIFY
Sources: README.md, docs/sdlc/README.md, AGENTS.md and backbone/HOOKS.md at v0.32.0.
Colour marks the role; the outline marks the status: solid is built and enforced, dashed is proposed or outside the harness.
